recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, medium shot of a man in a lime green blazer looking out from the window of a vintage red and black locomotive, set against a bright blue sky with wispy white clouds. The typography follows the physical contour of the train's roofline in a dynamic arc.
coreVisualRelationships: The man's lime green jacket provides a sharp complementary contrast to the red train body.
The text arc mimics the mechanical silhouette of the locomotive's cabin and nose.
The vast blue sky occupies the top half, balancing the heavy industrial weight of the train below.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the cabin
Text following a non-linear, arced path

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is framed within the cabin window, positioned in the middle-left third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, saturated red mass of the train's lower section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the man's face, follows the red text arc across the top of the train, and descends along the yellow text toward the train's nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper 40% of the frame is open sky, providing breathing room for the dense mechanical subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Saturated Red (Train body and primary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lime Green (Subject's jacket) and Bright Yellow (Secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary elements; high value contrast between the black cabin and the white clouds.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are individually rotated to follow the curve of the train roof

composition.position: Arched over the train cabin and nose

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-based hierarchy where the first half of the phrase is red and the second half is yellow.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, industrial feel and bold weight.
Provides the necessary vertical presence and thickness.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-saturation photograph of a vintage 1960s red and black locomotive from a low angle. A man in a lime green suit is looking out the window. The background is a bright blue sky with white clouds. Film grain and analog texture should be visible.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold sans-serif uppercase text in an arc following the roofline. Set the first half of the text in vibrant red and the second half in bright yellow. Rotate each letter to stay perpendicular to the train's curve.

verificationChecks: Is the text following the curve of the train?
Is the red of the train highly saturated?
Does the man's jacket provide a lime green accent?
Is the sky clear blue with natural clouds?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the locomotive red
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any unique branding or logos on the train
Exact letterforms of the original artist name
postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed between the red train and blue sky
Ensure the text arc feels physically connected to the train roof
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained
Confirm the lime green jacket is the primary focal point within the cabin
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial subject + complementary accent color + path-aligned bold typography + high-saturation analog film finish.
